verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs directly claim the app lets you "Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations," which names all three parts of the story. Only model downloading (in-app and via `lms get`) and per-load settings (`lms load` with GPU and context-length flags) are documented in any detail. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of saved-prompt management, persistent per-model configuration presets, a unified model-library management view, and hands-on corroboration of these features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
